name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid for picking a date or a date range, always visible on the page.

examples.name: calendar-demo
examples.title: Calendar
examples.description: Pick a single date. Today is marked with a dot.

examples.name: calendar-range
examples.title: Range
examples.description: RangeCalendar picks a start and end date.

examples.name: calendar-unavailable
examples.title: Limits and unavailable dates
examples.description: minValue/maxValue disable dates; isDateUnavailable strikes out dates that can't be booked.

examples.name: calendar-two-months
examples.title: Two months
examples.description: visibleDuration shows months side by side; paging moves by the whole duration.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name; the visible month is appended. Required unless labelled by aria-labelledby.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The selected date, controlled or initial (from @internationalized/date).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a date is selected.

props.name: minValue / maxValue
props.description: Earliest and latest selectable dates; dates outside are disabled.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Marks dates that can be focused but not selected (e.g. fully booked).

props.name: focusedValue / defaultFocusedValue
props.description: The date that has keyboard focus, which also sets the visible month.

props.name: visibleDuration
props.description: How many months to show side by side.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: Overrides the locale's first day of the week.

props.name: isDisabled / isReadOnly
props.description: Disables the whole calendar, or keeps it focusable but unchangeable.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Shows the selection in the danger colour and errorMessage.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the grid when isInvalid is true.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The selected range, controlled or initial.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when both ends of a range are picked.

props.name: allowsNonContiguousRanges
props.description: Allow ranges that span unavailable dates.

keyboard.action: Previous / next day (mirrored in right-to-left locales).
Same day in the previous / next week.
First / last day of the week.
Selects the focused date; in a range calendar the first press sets the start, the second the end.
Range calendar: cancels a half-picked range.
Moves between the previous/next buttons and the grid.

notes: The grid is role="grid"; each date has a full label (e.g. "Monday, September 14, 2026") so the weekday header is hidden from assistive tech.
The visible month is announced when it changes.
Today is marked with a dot and bold weight; unavailable dates are struck through and stay readable (text.subtle); disabled dates are muted and not focusable.
Previous/next buttons have localised names and flip direction in right-to-left layouts.
Motion follows prefers-reduced-motion: colour fades remain; the press dip, selected-day spring and month slide only run when motion is allowed.

do: Use an inline Calendar when the date is the main task on the screen (booking, scheduling).
Set minValue/maxValue rather than validating after the fact.
Use isDateUnavailable for dates that exist but can't be chosen, so people see why.
dont: Don't use an inline calendar in a dense form — use DatePicker.
Don't use a calendar for dates far from today, like a date of birth — type it in a DatePicker.
